Where Clinical Expertise Meets Prophetic Calling

Boladale Gold-Okelanfaa is a licensed clinician, prophetic voice, author, and healing ministry leader whose life's work sits at the sacred intersection of psychology and faith. A proud alumna of Bowie State University — where she earned her Bachelor of Arts in Sociology in 2008 and her Master of Arts in Counseling Psychology in 2012 — she graduated with such distinction that she was inducted as a Lifetime Member of the Alpha Chi Honor Society.

Her clinical journey began at the Adventist Behavioral Health Center's Adolescent Residential Treatment Center, where she worked with juveniles in residential care — and first witnessed the truth that would define her entire career: untreated parental pain does not stay with the parent. She went on to serve as a Therapist at Good Shepherd Services in Baltimore from 2014 to 2016, deepening her expertise with vulnerable populations before founding her own practice.

She saw mothers who believed God was punishing them through their children's pain — and she learned to redirect shame into love, breaking cycles that had run for generations. That signature move — from condemnation to compassion — became the foundation of everything she does.

Today, operating as Prophetess Boladale Gold-Okelanfaa, she serves individuals across trauma, mood, anxiety, relationships, and occupational stress — through her private practice, her international healing ministry, her four-book Amazon series, and the Moving Beyond healing platform. A devoted mother of six — Daniel, Adetola, Adewale, Gabby, Esther, and Joshua — she brings the fullness of lived experience to every room she enters.

The people of God cannot thrive when they cannot move beyond what broke them. That conviction is the heartbeat of everything she does.
